judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after the planning/test-writing phase and never actually modified `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to move `beforeSession` inside the `try` block. Because the production bug is completely unfixed, the newly added acceptance test in `src/orchestration/beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts` will fail immediately. Furthermore, the candidate omitted the required `CHANGELOG.md` update specified in the acceptance criteria and left behind an internal `.lore/dod.md` file. The only completed parts of the ticket are the update to `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and the test case.
